title: Audio Entries Format
description: Schema for entries.json audio mappings. Keys this schema does not list are not read.

items.description: An entry without accents or subentries adds no audio metadata.

kanji.description: List of terms associated with this entry. May be omitted or empty when kana is given. A string may join spellings with `，`; each is a term.

kana.description: The word in kana, used as the term when kanji is empty. A recording of the word whose pronunciation says the same is read as it; another is read as its pronunciation in hiragana, `ー` kept. A subentry's recordings are read as it.

subentries.description: Recordings of a phrase or count under the word. They are stored under the entry's terms and kana, labelled by `head`, else by `number`, as written.

notes.description: Notes the parts of a recording point to by `key`. A recording keeps the `text` of each note its parts point to, as written, in the order met. A note no recording points to is not stored. An item without a string `key` and `text` skips the entry.

soundFile.description: Path to the audio file in the archive. An accent without it, or with null, is not imported.

notStandardButPermissible.description: True tags the recording `notStandardButPermissible`. Another type skips the entry.

accent.description: The accent phrases of one recording, in order. A compound's pattern is the parts' patterns joined and has no downstep position.

pronunciation.description: How the part is spoken, in katakana with its marks (`キ゚`, `ー`). The parts' pronunciations joined are stored and shown as written.

pitchAccent.description: An integer is the downstep position (0 heiban), stored with the pattern computed from it, one letter per mora of the pronunciation. A string is the pattern, one `H` or `L` per mora of the pronunciation. A position past the morae, or a string of other letters or another length, stores no pitch: the recording is kept and the import warns once with the count. Another type skips the entry.

silencedMora.description: The devoiced morae of the part, 1 being its first; stored as the recording's devoiced morae, counted over the whole accent. A mora below 1 or past the part's morae is not stored: the recording keeps its other devoiced morae and the import warns once with the count. Anything but a list of integers skips the entry.

notStandardButPermissible.description: True tags the recording `notStandardButPermissible`. Another type skips the entry.

notes.description: Keys of the entry's `notes` that apply to the recording. A key the entry's notes do not have is skipped; the import warns once with the count and the first three entries.
